witness.branch: Intersection departure from the center lane
witness.quote: A vehicle must not travel more than 200 feet in a center turn lane before making a left-hand turn from the highway.
witness.reason: An intersection departure can activate the distance restriction when approached through the specified center lane.
required_context: Ego uses that lane before its left turn from the highway.

Public-highway status and a single center lane reserved exclusively for turns by both directions.
